_what: sha256 of the UNTRACKED row and cache files for the reader-transfer arm. results/** is gitignored (raw endpoint outputs are large); the small summaries are tracked under results/ledgers/gemma_reader/. These digests let a reader verify the local files are the ones the analysis read.
_caveat: A hash VERIFIES a file; it does not RECOVER one. The rows themselves are not redistributed here, so an outside reader can check integrity but cannot re-derive the numbers without the run.
